notes.title: Update 1.0.2.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.2.0

What's New?

Added:

 Zombie Vision (Under L ALT) – Highlight items and enemies to gain an edge.
 Gore – Enemies now have a chance of losing limbs when hit with powerful attacks (e.g., shotgun blasts).
 Vehicle Damage System – Your vehicle will gradually take damage when hitting enemies or obstacles.
 Ladders – You can now climb ladders, adding new tactical options.
 Shop – Buy items from designated NPCs.
 New Vehicles – The selection has expanded, check out what's available!
 New Map Locations – Explore fresh areas on the map.
 New Music – A few more tracks have been added to set the mood.


Improved:

 Movement – Now based on the ALS system, making movement look and feel super smooth.
 Loot – Item respawn times are longer, encouraging more strategic exploration of the world.

notes.title: Major Update Coming to Lost Hope!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This is Shadow Sparks Studios, the creators of Lost Hope. We want to inform you that work on the game is in full swing! We know you can't wait for the new updates, so we have great news for you. A major update is coming soon, bringing a lot of changes and new features to Lost Hope.

In this update, you can expect:

 Improved movement, making the game even more dynamic and fluid.
https://i.imgur.com/5L65kdd.gif

 Ladder system: from this update, players will be able to climb ladders.
https://i.imgur.com/Lr6DizC.gif

 Gore: enemies will lose limbs during combat, adding more realism and intensity to the fights.
https://i.imgur.com/EozWW5x.gif

 New items to discover, enriching your in-game experience.
 Additionally, we are introducing the Steam Market! From now on, you will be able to sell items obtained in the game to other players.
 Optimization: we are implementing fixes that will make the game run smoother and more efficiently.


The update is quite large, so we need a bit more time before we can release it. We are working on it intensively, so we ask for your patience and understanding. We are sure it will be worth the wait!

Thank you for your patience and support. Stay tuned, because an exciting time is coming for Lost Hope!

Best regards,  
Shadow Sparks Studios Team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
Tutorial Map Removal - The tutorial map has been removed to improve the first impressions of new players.
 Mission Correction - The marker for one of the main missions has been corrected; it now points to the correct location.
 Location Saving - The game now saves the player’s location upon exiting, allowing continuation from the point where the player left off.
 Multilanguage Support - English and Polish language support has been added, reaching a wider audience.
 ‘Take All’ Button - A ‘Take All’ button has been introduced to collect all items with a single click, facilitating inventory management.
 Icon Bug Fix - The issue with item icons unintentionally sticking to the mouse cursor has been resolved.
 Loading screen - Added Loading screen

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
Improved controller support: Enhanced compatibility and responsiveness of controllers.
 Added developer menu: Introduced a new menu for developers, facilitating testing and debugging.
 Changed lighting: Upgraded the lighting system to ensure better visual quality.
 Modified settings menu: Reorganized the menu to simplify navigation and customization of options.
 Fixed an axe-attack bug in third-person mode: Resolved an issue preventing axe attacks in third-person perspective.
 Fixed a bug with saving graphic settings: Addressed a problem with graphic preferences not being saved.
